name: baseUrl
label: Tracking Server URL
help: The base URL of your MLflow Tracking Server (self-hosted) or Databricks workspace URL (e.g. `https://adb-1234567890.1.azuredatabricks.net`). Do not include `/api` or a trailing slash — the plugin appends the API path itself.

name: authType
label: Authentication
help:
**No authentication:** for self-hosted MLflow servers with no auth configured.  
**Basic auth:** for self-hosted MLflow servers with [MLflow Authentication](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/auth/index.html) enabled.  
**Bearer token:** for Databricks-hosted MLflow (a personal access token or OAuth token) or any self-hosted server that authenticates via a bearer token.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.help: A Databricks personal access token, Databricks OAuth token, or any bearer token your MLflow server accepts.

name: experimentIds
label: Experiment IDs to track runs for (optional)
help: Comma or newline separated list of MLflow experiment IDs to import runs for. MLflow's run search API requires specific experiment IDs — there is no "all runs" endpoint. Leave blank to import runs from the Default experiment (ID `0`) only. Experiment IDs are visible once experiments have been imported (see the Experiments object type).

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to a self-hosted MLflow server with a self-signed certificate.
